headlines.title: Iowa residents mark Thanksgiving with lingering fears after chemical detonation
headlines.description: The U.S. Army blew up the nation’s entire stockpile of lead azide, a chemical used to make explosives, saying the first checks show Wednesday’s controlled detonation in Iowa didn’t spread toxic dust to nearby homes and farms.

headlines.title: Nvidia Reportedly Stops Chip Sales to 4 Southeast Asia Countries
headlines.description: Nvidia has reportedly stopped some sales of advanced chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, according to a report by The New York Times. The move comes amid a Trump administration crackdown to stop China benefitting from American technology.

headlines.title: Trump Weighs-in on Veto Power, Nvidia, Iran War and Putin
headlines.description: While making calls to U.S. troops for Thanksgiving, President Donald Trump addressed a number of issues, including how he plans to work with a Democrat-controlled congress, what he expects from AI chipmaker Nvidia’s future now that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as CEO, new details about what he told Russian President Vladimir Putin during their meeting in China, and more. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Administration Defends Iowa Detonation, Unveils New Tariffs
headlines.description: The White House is calling the controversial detonation of old explosives in Iowa a success, saying there is no health impact. This comes as the Trump administration reignites fears over a new trade war, proposing sweeping tariffs targeting 11 countries, the European Union and China. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Nebraska Sen. Deb Fischer’s husband died by suicide, spokesperson says
headlines.description: The husband of Sen. Deb Fischer, R-Neb., died by suicide, her office announced. Bruce Fischer made headlines for refusing to shake the hand of Kamala Harris in 2025.

headlines.title: Zohran Mamdani has successful surgery for torn Achilles and will make full recovery, staff says
headlines.description: Surgery to repair New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s Achilles tendon went well Friday and he’s now recovering at Gracie Mansion, his press secretary said.

headlines.title: Judge halts order requiring Fulton County to turn over copies of 2020 ballots
headlines.description: The judge previously ruled the county had to turn over unredacted digital copies of election materials to the State Election Board, which is run by Trump allies.

headlines.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia lands in Spain a ‘free man’ after deportation battle
headlines.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia is in Spain after voluntarily leaving the United States on Tuesday, ending a closely watched and controversial deportation battle that became a symbol of the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

headlines.title: Fort Hood mass shooter makes legal move to stop Pentagon’s firing squad execution
headlines.description: The former Army officer whose scheduled military execution by firing squad provoked outrage over an initial proposal to livestream his death is planning to file a constitutional challenge that could halt his December execution, his lawyers said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Trump says pardon is always an option for Huang, and that invoking the Fifth isn’t necessary
headlines.description: The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week.

headlines.title: Judge orders Georgia’s Fulton County to turn over copies of 2020 ballots to Trump-allied election board
headlines.description: The State Election Board, which sets and enforces Georgia’s election rules, is under the control of activists aligned with Trump and his false claims of a stolen election.
